lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular clusters of high-luminance pixels arranged in quasi-linear vertical columns. Blobs show varying diameters, with larger clusters positioned mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, forming a discernible coordinate-like grid across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features defined by sharp vertical pixel intensity gradients; the primary ridge exhibits high luminance on the upper boundary and low luminance on the lower boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a cluster of high-intensity blobs, with a higher concentration of pixels in the lower posterior quadrant of the fin area.
